title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text: 53. Notes with concern that OLAF opened eight investigations in 2023, which are still ongoing, concerning potential misconduct in the context of procurement procedures and implementation of contracts, grant agreements or potential irregularities related to human-resource matters; expresses deep concern over the alleged case uncovered by OLAF, which found that certain EEAS diplomats operated an illegal alcohol and cigar smuggling network during their Southeast Asia postings, violating Union rules and the prohibition on abusing diplomatic privileges; condemns the fact that those involved exploited their official EU positions and the tax and customs exemptions associated with their diplomatic status for personal gain, severely damaging the credibility and reputation of Union institutions; calls on the EEAS to immediately publish the results of its internal investigations and ensure that appropriate disciplinary and legal actions are taken. Emphasises that stricter control mechanisms and ethical rules must be introduced to prevent such cases, particularly regarding abuses of diplomatic privileges; calls on the EEAS to report to Parliament on the measures taken in response to this case and on its proposals to strengthen transparency and accountability mechanisms;
